combine.arrangeSubtitle: Reorder and rename each part, then combine into one document.
combine.keepOpen: Keep the app open. Large documents with images and equations can take a few minutes.
combine.fullSetupOn: Each part gets a divider page, a running header and a chapter heading. Plain titles inside your files become real headings, the numbers you typed by hand are replaced by automatic numbering, and one font is applied from the standard above.
combine.fullSetupOff: Files are joined in order and nothing else changes. Each part starts its own section on a new page, keeping the formatting you wrote it with.
combine.continuesPrevious: This file continues the part above
combine.stepHeadings: Adding headings, numbering and divider pages
combine.aiFailed_key_rejected: The AI provider rejected our key, so these names come from each file's own text. Edit any that look wrong.
combine.aiFailed_no_credit: The AI account is out of credit, so these names come from each file's own text. Edit any that look wrong.
combine.aiFailed_rate_limited: The AI is rate-limited right now, so these names come from each file's own text. Edit any that look wrong.
combine.aiFailed_model_denied: The AI model refused this request, so these names come from each file's own text. Edit any that look wrong.
combine.aiFailed_model_missing: The configured AI model is no longer available, so these names come from each file's own text. Edit any that look wrong.
combine.aiFailed_unreachable: The AI wasn't reachable, so these names come from each file's own text. Edit any that look wrong.
combine.aiFailed_bad_reply: The AI answered with something unusable, so these names come from each file's own text. Edit any that look wrong.
combine.aiFailedTitle: The AI couldn't name your parts
combine.heuristicNotice: The AI wasn't reachable, so these names come from each file's own text. Edit any that look wrong.

aiKey.title: Your own AI key
aiKey.lead: Use the app for free with your own key
aiKey.explainer: Add an API key from your own AI provider account and the app's AI runs on it. You pay your provider directly for what you use, and we charge you nothing.
aiKey.keyHint: Stored in your device's secure keychain. Sent to our server only to run your requests — never saved there.
aiKey.modelHint: Leave empty to use an inexpensive model. A stronger model gives better writing and costs you more.
aiKey.statusOn: The AI runs on your key and your account is billed.
aiKey.statusOff: Turned off — the app uses our AI instead.
aiKey.errorKeyRejected: Your provider rejected this key. Check that you copied it in full and that it is still active.
aiKey.errorInsufficientCredit: Your provider account is out of credit. Top it up to keep using the AI.
aiKey.errorRateLimited: Your provider is rate-limiting this key. Wait a moment and try again.
aiKey.errorModelDenied: Your provider would not run this model with this key. Try another model, or check your account's data settings.
aiKey.errorKeyInvalid: That key doesn't look right. Paste it again from your provider dashboard.
